labels.title: Add a label
labels.description: Labels allow to create aliases inside mx_hal_def.h file like '<label>_init', '<label>_deinit' and '<label>_gethandle'. These aliases can be used on application side.

actions.message: Name must be a valid C identifier: start with a letter or underscore, and contain only letters, digits, or underscores.

init_type.title: Resource initialization code generation
init_type.description: Pick whether the initialization code should be generated and automatically called at startup.

oneOf.title: Callable
oneOf.description: Initialization code is generated and called in peripheral initialization.

eth_kernel_clock_source.title: Kernel clock source
eth_kernel_clock_source.description: Ethernet kernel clock source can be modified in clock tree.

actions.message: The clock source is determined by the selected clock source in the clock tree and cannot be directly edited here. Please modify the clock tree configuration to change the Ethernet kernel clock source.

eth_kernel_clock_frequency.title: Kernel clock frequency
eth_kernel_clock_frequency.description: Ethernet kernel clock frequency can be modified in clock tree.

actions.message: The clock frequency is determined by the selected clock source in the clock tree and cannot be directly edited here. Please modify the clock tree configuration to change the Ethernet kernel clock frequency.
The internal clock provided to the Ethernet IP should be 25, 50, 100, or 125 MHz depending on the selected media interface.
The SBS parameters will be updated depending on the selected value here.

loopback_mode.title: Loopback Mode
loopback_mode.description: Enable the loopback mode for the Ethernet MAC.

max_tx_ch_nb.title: User defined number of transmit channels
max_tx_ch_nb.description: Provides the user defined number of transmit channels to be used by the application. The maximum number of channels that can be configured is limited by the ETH_NUM_TXQ feature of the selected device.

max_rx_ch_nb.title: User defined number of receive channels
max_rx_ch_nb.description: Provides the user defined number of receive channels to be used by the application. The maximum number of channels that can be configured is limited by the ETH_NUM_RXQ feature of the selected device.

max_app_buffers_num.title: Maximum number of buffers
max_app_buffers_num.description: Provides the Maximum number of Application Buffers to be hold in the DMA FIFO.

align_desc_size.title: Memory alignment constraint
align_desc_size.description: Enable the application requested descriptor memory size alignment.

actions.message: If the requested size alignment is zero, then the driver will not align the descriptor size. Otherwise, the driver will use size alignment value which respect both descriptor size alignment and requested size alignment conditions.

req_desc_size_align_byte.title: Memory size alignment value in bytes
req_desc_size_align_byte.description: Provides the application requested descriptor memory size alignment in bytes.

actions.message: This value is only relevant if 'Memory alignment constraint' is enabled.
The memory size alignment must be equal to '1', greater than or equal to the bus width.
The memory size alignment must be a multiple of the bus width.
The application can request specific descriptor size alignment to implement proper CACHE maintenance.

oneOf.description: ETH interrupt is disabled - Polling mode, no interrupt.

oneOf.description: ETH FIFO event on every executed descriptor.

oneOf.title: Cyclic
oneOf.description: ETH interrupt after every N buffers. This mode reduces interrupt load for high-throughput operation.

event_params.title: Number of buffers per event cycle
event_params.description: Event parameter. The value could be one of the following : - Number of buffers to execute by the DMA to trig the interrupts when mode=HAL_ETH_FIFO_EVENT_CYCLIC. - or anything (to be ignored by the driver) when mode=HAL_ETH_FIFO_EVENT_ALWAYS or mode=HAL_ETH_FIFO_EVENT_NONE.
